text:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Bind comparative claims to the ten-head cohort**

Once any ten pull requests establish `real_pr_measured`, this condition allows a comparative claim from controls covering an arbitrarily smaller set of heads: for example, an operator can record a control for one favorable head and satisfy the remaining recall, variance, or cost requirements on that head alone. That bypasses the stated ten-PR minimum and reintroduces post-adjudication selection bias. Require the matched comparison to cover the complete closed cohort, or independently require at least ten preselected, fully adjudicated matched heads.
